verdict.rationale: An online filing portal could plausibly offer a full-parity API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only UI-driven workflows: online filing, dashboards, tracking, payment modules and signature via FranceConnect+. Nothing documents a Guichet unique API for creating or filing formalities. The only working machine endpoint in the pack is the separate recherche-entreprises read API, which belongs to a different product and does not count toward this story.
